facts.fact: The high court sat nine days before Rema reached Kettamala and entered Asha's murder and the pass sales as one conspiracy; it authorised Rema to record any charter made in daylight before witnesses.
facts.why: needed because the beat says the high court has entered Asha's finding and Rema will record a charter.

facts.fact: Devan took the oilcloth bundle from the shutter-frame hollow at dawn of the day of the reading and carried it against his ribs.
facts.why: needed because he reads the writ in the hall.

facts.fact: The queen asks for one night and will answer at noon at the old watch-house on the shoulder above the narrows, which Neela requests for the Company's hall.
facts.why: needed because ch 31 opens at noon at the watch-house.

facts.fact: Lata self-names to Usha and Kamalakshi self-names to Janu at dusk, with the garrison facing the wall; shapes are not spoken on the page.
